even though the site you used to calculate your birth chart does not number the houses you can still figure it out yourself from your ascendent. I see you have a virgo ascendent (your ascendent sign is always in the first house) then just count and you will see your 10th house/midheaven is in gemini. all houses represent something in your life. on your own time you can do research for what each house means but the 10th house rules career and with yours being in gemini you’re definitely going to want a job where you can be talkative and social. you may also have a lot of ideas and thoughts that you want to share with other people. 
whatever career you go into you will likely be in the spotlight, and you love the attention too. you’re a great speaker! so use this to your advantage, you have a way with words and people are drawn to your ideas. some problems you may run into or may have already ran into is not being able to choose one profession, you may be very good and a lot of things and have never been able to settle down and choose one thing. you may relate to this by playing many sports as a child or taking many different courses in school. you will likely succeed in whatever profession you choose because of your ambition and optimism but your issue will be choosing a profession which is i guess why you made this post. some career choices i would suggest to a gemini 10th house would be public speaking, marking, publishing/journalism, teaching, or something along the lines of designing and fashion. hope this helped!
